company_info.company_description: "Chief Electricians is a local solar energy retailer and installer, with over 10 years of experience in the renewable energy space. As a New Energy Tech Approved Seller, we can help eligible homeowners apply for the Victorian Solar Rebate, giving you the greatest possible saving on your system.We utilise exclusively in-house CEC (SAA) Accredited designers and Installers, who use cutting edge software and internal governance frameworks to make sure our solar systems are installed efficiently and with absolute precision. We know how important it is to provide you with absolute peace of mind and the security of knowing that your solar installer is exactly who you signed up for.Unlike hundreds of our competitors, we don’t use external sub-contractors, meaning we can confidently ensure the same standard of experience and reliability on all our jobs. In other words, the Chief Electricians team will provide a comprehensive start-to-finish service.In-house team of expertly trained electricians, no use of external sub-contractors.Obligation free site inspections for all installs.Comprehensive and concise quotes, with no hidden costs.Tailored solutions for you and your home, we will never sell you a system over the phone.Strong warranty and installation guarantees, we stand behind our work and workers."

reviews.review_description: I am extremely happy with the Chief Electricians team, they did a great job installing my system and were there to answer my questions that I have had. My reason for choosing them from the 3 quotes I received from Solar quotes was that they came to my site to see where I wanted to install the battery and explain the best option for my solar, they were also the most competitive in price. I would highly recommend them.

Such a great experience with the team who installed my solar panels! They were super friendly, professional, and really knew what they were doing. Everything ran smoothly from start to finish, and they had excellent after care service.Highly recommend this company, they have an excellent, switched on, and very polite team.

Adam and the team were terrific from word go. I felt extremely comfortable in their knowledge of the system. The install process was quick and easy. The followup service from Veronika and Dylan were terrific. I'd highly recommend them to anyone looking to get a solar and battery system!
This was for an upgrade to our existing battery installation that Chief Electricians originally did. Had no hesitation in going back to them for the upgrade. Great quality install.

I had my solar battery upgraded to double its capacity. Quotation process was fast and easy.Once the tentative installation date came, installers were very quick to come and install the battery. Everyone was quick and professional.The upgraded battery works perfectly, and the overall solar power system has been working perfectly for years.
Very good to work with. Punctual and prompt to resolve any installation issues and professional to deal with. Highly recommended.

Chief Electricians were very responsive to our requirements and quickly provided several very well priced options with full details. Installation was done in a very professional manner, keeping us fully updated on progress including delays due to weather etc. All of the paperwork required came with full instructions on how to complete it and when in doubt, we were able to easily contact them for assistance which was readily offered. Things such as the grid connection were mainly delt with by them and we found there was little for us to manage.One thing we were really happy about was their proactive attitude in contacting us during the install about new offers available, allowing us to make changes to the system at a very good price. They were clear on what the implications of the change would be to the price of the system and what the timeframe would be.

Chief Electricians were always able to answer my queries and were most willing to take the time to establish what system would be best for my situation. This process included me having input and offering some challenging questions to ensure that I understood the technical aspects, and for me to be satisfied that I was going to have a system that was both suitable for today and also for well into the future.  Times and schedules were honoured, communication was always part of the service so that there were no misunderstandings and that interruption to the household was kept to a minimum.    From my judgement, the quality of the work was kept to a very high level that left nothing for me to query or even complain about.    With the system now having been operational for some time, I am more than pleased with the expenditure, the work quality the system configuration and what it delivers as an overall package.  I did give the 'Expenditure' star rating only four as I will always ask for products and services to be cheaper!

Could not fault the entire process from quoting to installation to after-sales support.The installation of my solar system was professional and flawless. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and explained the setup clearly. The system, installed a few months now, is performing very well and I am super pleased with it. Moreover, after-sales support has been outstanding—with smooth organization of grid connection, and prompt and thorough assistance for every support query I raised.I highly recommend Adam and his company for a reliable and well designed solar solution.

Chief Electricians were quick to respond with a quote and happily came to site within a couple of days of making contact. The site visit was very useful in helping us clarify details of how the installation would happen and where to locate the hardware, which ended up including a Mitsubishi split system in our open plan living room.The Project Co-ordinator communicated daily and the onsite team was organised, with minimal impact to our garden. The team worked hard not to break ancient terracotta tiles and came prepared with a supply of replacements - which we did need. A few post completion questions have been followed up in a timely manner.Really satisfied with their work and have already recommended them to a friend, who is interested in adding a battery to their existing solar.

From day 1 when I spoke with Jamey to discuss my needs he quickly got back to me with a detailed quote for a 12.76kW Solar System with a Tesla PW3 of 13.5kWh.Adam the owner came to site during the install and he and his team were very tidy, polite and efficient during the whole process. I would also like to thank Luke for his technical knowledge and also to Veronika in the office who kept me up to date at all times.Thanks to Solar Quotes for recommending Chief Electricians to me, and I have no hesitation in recommending them to others looking to install or upgrade their solar system.

Adam was super personable on the phone, came out to site, did a thorough review of the property, then sent a team of guys out who did an excellent job. Couldn't be happier with the process and outcome. Will definitely recommend and use Chief again!

The team at chief electricians have been stellar right from quotation stage of the process thru to installation and post installation of my solar panels and batteries. Thank you Jamie, Adam and Veronika for always being patient and spot on with their answers and recommendations. The installation team Charlie, Jack & others were also very friendly and meticulous with my solar and battery installations. High praises to solar quotes for including this company in their list of reputable and professional solar installers.

We had a great experience with Chief Electricians when they installed our solar system, so when we decided to install a battery we contacted them again.  Adam advised us as to the best fit for our system and the quote was submitted promptly.  Installation was problem free and all the staff from Chief Electricians are great to deal with, thorough and experienced.  Very polite, arrive on time and are excellent at explaining how the system works. They helped us with the Tesla app so we can check anytime on how much charge we have and how much solar we are exporting.They organised the grid connection and the inspection.  Vey happy to highly recommend this company.

We wanted to add a second solar PV system to the South facing section of our roof.Chief Electricians were one of the few installers to come back to us via an enquiry on their website and they were an attractive option due to being close by and doing all the work in-house.The sales and quoting process was very easy. Adam and Jamey were extremely helpful throughout the process in getting a design to suit our needs. Because we were looking at getting a South facing system we required a cost effective solution to compensate for the non-ideal orientation. Adam also visited us for a preliminary site inspection on May 2 which allowed some roof measurements to be taken and helped answer a few questions we had about how the new system would work alongside our existing system (smoothly as it turns out). Jamey helped to update the quote to maximise the number of panels we could fit in the new system and find a design which would work with our existing PV system and battery (as well as being compliant with new regulations in Victoria). The Chief team were also able to arrange with our distributor to increase their solar inverter limit (from 10kW to 11kW) for our house, allowing us to get a larger inverter in the new system.We received very comprehensive documentation during the quoting process which allowed us to see expected yield over the course of an average year as well as panel and inverter model numbers and layouts of the various options. This helped us to make the right decision and ensure we should get a reasonable payback period.The installation was completed over a couple of days and it was good to see the team working safely with scaffolding around our tricky 2 storey roof. The install was very tidy with the cabling completely hidden internally rather than on the outside wall to the back of the house. There was a minor cosmetic issue with brickwork on the outside wall near the inverter, however the team were very up-front and apologetic about this and managed to fix the issue on the day of install. The end result was very neat and looks great on our roof and garage wall where there inverter is mounted.The install team cleaned everything up after finishing and showed us how to log into the monitoring portal.The install was completed on May 26 and the inspection and powering on was done a couple of weeks later on June 6. Veronika and Dylan and the team were also very communicative and proactive in letting us know what was happening at each stage and providing all the paperwork after the install. So far the system is performing very well and in line with expectations.We would not hesitate to recommend Chief Electricians for their fantastic service in expanding an existing solar and battery system!

Chief Electricians initally installed a new 20 kw Rooftop Solar system, to replace an old smaller one, for us in February 2025. They were the only ones who were willing, and able, to install the new infrastructure in the optimum location for us, and did an excellent job.Consequently we contracted them again, recently, to install a 25kw battery addition to the new system. The inverter was already battery enabled, at their suggestion, in February.Everything went smoothly and the battery was turned on 3 July.In both jobs we were continually informed of progress and often contacted to make sure we were happy.Cannot speak more highly of the dedication of the installers and the office staff in making sure everything went smoothly.Everything was done for us from the sales/quoting process right through to connection.

Sales/quoting was quick and easy. Customer service staff well informed and helpful.The careful and thorough pre-install site inspection found we needed an upgrade to the cabling, which required an adjustment to the quote.On the day all went well. The team was great - polite and happy to answer questions. The replacement of the cabling and the battery install ran smoothly. They arrived on time, did the job, explained what they had done and tidied up before they left. Job well done!Highly recommended!

Adam and Installer Luke and the whole team were simply excellent.The sizable system included a battery and was completed with a minimum of fuss and to a 5 star standard. All the team members were polite and efficient and clearly know their stuff!I Have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone considering installing solar.

The process of getting a quote was simple and fast, on site inspection same week and then install around the corner.On site inspection identified challenges and the staff member offered remedies to overcome them.Simple and easy install.

We went with Chief Electricians after a family member recommended them and were impressed with the service from start to finish. Very friendly and helpful staff who helped us plan our system - they seemed to enjoy answering all our questions, and didn't seem at all put out or annoyed when we wanted to change the design a few times (including adding on a battery). They also went above and beyond in negotiating with our local council to help us get the planning permit we needed due to a heritage overlay. The installers were also lovely to deal with, and the install was completed more quickly than we expected. The system looks beautiful and we're loving it! Can't recommend the team at Chief Electricians highly enough!

Extremely neat install. The team were all extremely professional with communication and respectful with how they acted while working at the property.Help and support was giving to navigate around the smart phone app and Adam was on hand to explain how I could keep monitor the power savings.Would go out my way to recommend these guys to anyone.
Quoting was very quick and easy, spoke over the phone which I appreciated. The installers on the day were punctual and got everything done neatly and efficiently.

It was a very professional approach from the sales / quoting to the installation of the solar panels, all staff were very polite and I was kept informed all the way through..They left the area in an immaculate condition on completion. They explained how to power on/off the inverter if needed. The customer service during the whole process was excellent.I would have no hesitation to contact Chief Electricians for any further electrical work.

From sales, installation & communication with the Victorian/Federal government including our electrical supplier Ausnet. Everything went smoothly.Fair price & different options to choose which solar system.The installers were polite & professionalCustomer service were very polite & assisted with any queries, I required

The sales and quoting process was the memorable element of process. After receiving multiple quotes, Chief Electricians was the only company that talked us through our options. We had a lot to learn about the capacity of our electrical system and the best size solar system for our future selves. Jamey talked us through the decision making process with patience.Installation was organised swiftly and professionally. No issues with installation.Chief has taken care of all of the paperwork and working between agencies. They have made setting up solar power simple for us.

I’m a fussy retiree and chronic D-I-Y enthusiast who likes to keep an eye on things.  We had a 12+ year old set of solar panels that needed updating.   I wanted a larger system and battery backup.  Solar Quotes offered three installers but only one, Chief Electricians came on site to quote which was detailed.  Another installer said our roof wasn’t suitable, and the third was unimpressive.  Chief Electricians paperwork was both professional and detailed. Email flow and SMS use was informative, workmanship exemplary, and removal of their debris thorough.  And the system does everything I wanted it to.

Chief Electricians are absolute experts at installing solar in the most professional manner.  Adam and his team were not only great guys, but very skilled and informative in solar installation.  We had just had our roof restored prior to fitting the solar panels and they looked after it very well with no damage at all.  The commitment to ensure that all regulations were met, compliance obtained and the after fitment follow-up was excellent.  We cannot recommend Chief Electricians high enough. If you want solar, do yourself a great favour and employ Chief Electricians.  Thanks Adam & Team.

The quotation process was efficient and within our budgetThe install was extremely well cared out with very little disruption to usThe connection to the grind was prompt and within their time lineWe were given full instructions how to use the charger including shut down process in an emergencyAll the staff were friendly hard working and politeI would certainly recommend this organisation to any future customers

Chief Electricians were extremely professional and spent time to assess the site and our current and future needs to design the right solar system.The installation was flawless and included the removal of an old solar PV system and some old solar hot water panels. There was nothing to clean up as this had all been taken care of.The team took the time to explain how everything works and confirmed everything was working before leaving site. Grid connection was all organised for us as well.Very happy with our new system and look forward to purchasing a battery from Chief Electricians in the near future.

Adam and Chief Electricians demonstrated quality all round. From first engagement, through to completion, we were communicated throughout the whole process, with no room for surprises. The property was left, and tidy, and the quality of work was great. Adam checked in twice, building the confidence that any questions can be answered. Great man, Great company. Highly recommended.

The process was very easy, all set up via phone call. Provided with multiple options which I was able to chop and change on whim. Chief electricians to accommodate and completed the job promptly with no issues. Left the job site clean and tidy. Their admin team worked through all the paperwork and dealt with the energy companies. Very satisfied, would highly recommend!

The Chief Electricians quote was competitive, despite my requirement for the placement of the inverter needing additional finicky work. No one else would contemplate doing this.The installation took a little longer than expected (see above) but was otherwise done very efficiently. We were kept informed at all times of how the work was progressing.On completion, and throughout the installation, the work area was carefully cleaned up. Final result was  neat and tidy.The office kept in touch at all times and informed us regularly of how all the post installation connections were progressing.

Chief Electricians kept me up to date and informed every step of the journey. They were helpful in determining which battery and inverter options would be the most appropriate for my 3 phase power setup.The team did a fantastic job with the installation. They were friendly, polite, punctual and ensured that the design facade of my property was maintained and not impeded.The workmanship from Chief Electricians was top quality. They ensured that any rubbish or debris were tidied up and removed upon job completion.The solar inspector complimented the work performed on my property by Chief Electricians and provided his approval quickly. He advised that Chief Electricians always do fantastic work compared to some other solar installers in the market.I'd recommend Chief Electricians to anyone considering a solar inspection.
Top tier installer. The service was excellent, the installation went smoothly and the solar system works perfectly.

Sales and Quoting process was fine - but was promised installation timing which then wasn't possible.Then, when installation took place, it was over 3 weeks before the installation was certified, so I couldn't use the solar during that time. Another 3 weeks to get set up to get credits when electricity was going back to the grid. This really needs to be made clear upfront.
The experience was customer focussed from initial enquiry and establishing my needs through to ordering and final installation.

The sale and price were easily agreed upon. The system installation went very smoothly. Everything about the system and all the small problems that occurred were resolved at the speed of light. The support service and other staff are extremely friendly. And after the installation, they contacted me to check if everything was working properly.

After deciding to get solar I obtained quotes from three installers via the Solar Quotes website. I requested a number of options (different panels and inverters) so I could see the impact to price of the different brands/products. Chief Electricians were very responsive, providing me these multiple quotes and gave me advice on what might suit my needs best, without feeling like they were trying to pressure me into a particular brand/product. Once decided, the installation was seamless - they turned up on the day/time specified, got the installation done quickly, cleaned up after themselves and explained the next steps (around grid connection). What I really appreciated is how up front they were with risks prior to installation (e.g not able to put the panels in some of the proposed positions due to roof format) and discussed alternatives with me beforehand so when anything did arise I was already fully informed and a back up plan in place.I was a little concerned as we had just had the roof repointed and painted, but they were very careful.I've now had the system up and running for 5 months and it has been fantastic, we have had no issues with it, can track our usage in real time and my energy bills are even lower than they projected! If you are thinking of getting Solar, I would highly recommend you choose Chief Electricians as your installer.
Our installation was on 11 and 12 December. We were very happy with the quoting and installation process. The Chief staff are noticeably courteous. They have organised grid connection.

The initial stages of my experience were positive. The Chief Electricians responded promptly and provided reasonable quotes for the work.However, my installation proved to be more complex than anticipated, as it involved both the removal of an existing solar system and the installation of the Tesla Powerwall 3, which had not yet arrived in the country.Unfortunately, my experience began to decline as the installation process progressed. Communication from the team was poor, and they consistently failed to meet the agreed-upon timelines. I found myself repeatedly reaching out for updates, and while they expressed apologies and some delays seemed beyond their control, the lack of transparency was frustrating and unacceptable.Once the installation was completed and signed off by the inspector, I discovered that the wall charger, which was part of the installation, was malfunctioning. After several unsuccessful attempts to resolve the issue with them, I raised a support ticket directly with Tesla, who addressed the problem within a few days.While Chief Engineering is capable of good work, the overall experience has been disappointing. The delays associated with the Powerwall 3 may explain some of the setbacks, but the majority of the delays were within their control. As a result, I am hesitant to recommend their services.

The process of our install was complicated by end of the 60c+ FIT and rain and the office not recognising our deposit.  That said Adam worked really hard to service our needs and the guys doing the install were great.  Now to hope that the inspector and United Energy do their part.

Amongst my experiences with the various tradies and solar installers, Chief Electricians has  provided a professional installation experience. They know what they are doing, and it’s a well oiled process, giving comfort that the install is going to be done well.

Adam and the team at Chief Electricians were so knowledgeable and great to work with. They pride themselves in their workmanship, attention to detail, communication and efficiency. We were so happy overall with the product and service they provided and will definitely be using their services again in future and recommending them to our family and friends.

Excellent outcome for installation of 6.6 kw solar in Malvern East.Every effort was made to maximise and enhance the system for our suitable roof area.We appreciated consultation with Trevor to maximise output of the system.Care and safety was obvious throughout the installation.Thank youGraeme M

We recently had solar panels installed and couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the team at Chief Electricians was incredibly professional and provided excellent guidance throughout the entire process. They offered great advice and options tailored to our needs, making it easy to choose the best solution for our home.What stood out the most was their exceptional customer service and prompt support. They were always available to answer questions and quickly addressed any concerns. The paperwork, which we thought would be daunting, was handled seamlessly thanks to their clear and thorough guidance.Overall, they made the entire process stress-free and straightforward. We highly recommend them to anyone considering solar panels – their expertise and dedication are unmatched!

We are very happy with the service and workmanship of Chief Electricians. The design of the solar system was tailored to our roof to enable the maximum panels possible with half of the panels facing north and half facing west. Their quote was clear with no hidden costs and the installation was completed on time. The inspector who switched the system on commented on the neatness of the battery and inverter installation. We are delighted with our solar system which is working well.

The quoting process was very detailed and promptThe Installation went great - it all works perfectly and looks great.  The team were polite tidy and punctualThe customer service was great too with detail ed user instructions supplied, grid connection arranged and any questions or queries answered right away.

The team at Chief Electricians stood out from the beginning. They made an appointment to check out the site before they offered any advice. The other installers we contacted did not do this. They considered many details in providing advice about where to locate the EV charger. Once we decided to proceed with them, they were quick to arrange installation. The installer was great. He listened to our needs and provided the best solution for our situation. The work was very neat and tidy. We are very happy with the installation and to date it is running perfectly.At times we found it difficult to establish contact with them. However, once contact was established, they were great to work with.

The team were really professional, punctual and followed up on any queries.The team provided a range of options to choose from and did all the paperwork to get the system up and running. Installation team were really professional, polite and on time.

Kept us informed at every stage. Always responded to calls. The installation went ahead as expected on time and on the money. The team were happy and efficient. Our neighbour was listening in and commented how energetic and fun they had been. At this time, all connection paperwork permits etc have been well managed.

We had a great experience installing our solar system with Chief Electricians. Adam, Hamish, Luke and the team were fantastic to deal with and very patient with our questions (and with my kids’ interest in the proceedings during installation!). We particularly liked being able to package other work (including installing a split system and induction cooktop - as well as other electrical work) to help us on the journey to electrifying our home and making the most of our solar. Lovely people - definitely recommend.

Chief Electronics supplied and installed Fronius EV charger for me. The price was  very reasonable and the service was great. They actually found a better way to route wires and better location for the charger that I initially thought and suggested.After the installation they helped with configuration and answered post-installation questions quickly and professionally. The installation was a year ago and the charger works flawlessly since then.I highly recommend this installer.

I originally thought I would install additional panels to replace an old system whose inverter had failed. When Adam came out to have a look as part of the quoting process, he worked out that he could replace the inverter with a second-hand one like-for-like. This turned out to a simpler and cheaper option.

From the first phone call with Adam to the final visit post installation, Chief Electricians provided a great experience.  Prior to signing up, Jamey in sales was super patient and accommodating as I explored what our final configuration would look like and helped us avoid a matching error between our inverter and battery, and Adam visited our home to confirm that our desired location for the hardware was OK.Great communication and flexibility with coordinating removing our old small system before a roof clean and restoration beforehand.The installation process was super clean and neat.  Trevor, Luke and the boys were great to have around the house and happily answered all my questions.  Trevor suggested a slight change to the string design on the day once we talked about shading.Adam called me a couple of days after the install to make sure I was happy.I spoke with about a dozen installers before deciding on Chief Electricians and I couldn't be more pleased with the result.I have no hesitation to recommend Chief Electricians.

Installer provided three EV chargers to choose from. I'm very pleased with the chosen Zappi.Installer arrived on time and did a very neat and tidy job, then did a run through of the charger's options and features.The charger has been in use for about 6 months now and does the job beautifully.Can't think of anything I'd change or do differently.

Would thoroughly recommend Adam and his team. Adam performed an excellent site visit prior to the quote, taking the time to climb up on the roof and photograph the area for advice on optimal panel layout. They were very flexible in terms of a specific layout given I live in an area with a heritage overlay, and even threw in a couple more ideas I hadn't thought of. They were able to accommodate an install on a steep roof.The installation team were prompt and professional. Follow up communication was also excellent. Would not hesitate to recommend Chief Electricians to anyone interested in a solar install.

The team at Chief Electricians were faultless through the entire process. They were responsive in getting in contact with me. Asked all the right questions to be able to understand what I was looking for. Presented a couple of different options to me with pros and cons for each - and everything was installed and working super quick after I accepted the quote. Great to know that there's local companies out there leading the way in this space.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Chief Electricians for the installation of a solar power system at my home, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the results. From start to finish, the entire process was smooth, professional, and exceeded my expectations.The team at Chief Electricians demonstrated a deep knowledge of solar energy and provided clear guidance on the best options for my energy needs. They explained every step of the installation process, ensuring I fully understood how the system would work and the benefits I could expect.The installation itself was done efficiently and with great attention to detail. The electricians were punctual, respectful of my property, and ensured everything was done to the highest standard. They even cleaned up after the job, leaving my home looking as tidy as when they arrived.

Adam and his team were amazing to deal with from start to finish. Although they can be busy, they still took the time to come over and complete a first inspection to check the roof spacing before finalising the quote. Once it was all completed, Adam organised a time to go over the system and its functions.

We received three recommendations for installers from SolarQuotes.  Narrowed it down to two very quickly but what nailed it for Chief Electricians was the attention to detail from Adam during the site visit.  He took the time to clamber up onto our roof and measure accurately the area to maximise the kWh we could fit on an irregular space with some shading issues.  Adam was able to offer advice on installation so that we can easily install more panels in the future.Another plus for us is that Chief are smaller local Melbourne company who employ in-house installation teams.  The installation team were upbeat, thorough and engaged in their task. It's a neat job with no mess left behind.Chief organised all the paperwork for rebates and connection and chased up ESV for us when the final safety sign off seemed to be taking longer than we expected.

Dealing with Adam and the team was great.They are informative, decisive and really easy to have onsite.Adam's knowledge was a big help in making decisions and his follow-up was excellent.I would not hesitate to recommend Chief Electricians to anyone.  They made the process easy and quick.

Chief Electricians was very helpful from the get go, Adam and team patiently walked me through the process and answere any queries I had without hesitance.Installation on the part of Chief Electrician was smooth. Not withstanding the weather conditions.I was well consulted throughout the process, installation albeit delayed by rain was rescheduled promptly.They left the site clean and followed up thereafter as well.I am still waiting on UE to complete the variation to my connection, but Adam and team are still on hand to help follow up and push things along.

Got some different options on the quotes and listened to what I was after and I am really happy with the outcome of the panels and inverter.Installation went quick and it was nice and tidy afterwards.Connection to the grid went quick and after 2 weeks from the installation it was up and running.

SolarQuotes provided three companies who were well rated in our area. Two of them came out to inspect our property and suggest the type and placement of the components. Chief Electricians offered the most logical suggestions. Once the installation was booked in, they were punctual, tidy and polite. After installation, Adam came around a few times to test the system and teach us how the various components worked. Our first months electricity bill was virtually zero except for connection fees. We are very happy that even in winter (the end of) in Melbourne we are able to charge the battery and the EV from solar. Adam has made contact on a number of occasions to ask how the system is working and to see if we need any further assistance. Very happy with the whole process.

The team at Chief Electricians was professional and helpful from the start. They provided clear quotes and good guidance  throughout. Installation was efficient and punctual. Great customer service from start to finish. Overall, good communication, patience, friendly and reliable. Highly recommended.

The team at Chief Electricians were everything you could ask for. Friendly, courteous & efficient. Took great care & did an amazing neat job. Showed me how to setup the apps afterwards. I heartily recommend the entire group.
Adam and the team at Chief Electricians provided me with exceptional service when I needed help. I would highly recommend their services.

Adam and his team did a great job installing my Tesla Wall Charger. They were prompt, punctual and communicative throughout the morning on what they were doing. I was happy with the service both from the back office, as well as the guys who did the installation.

The Solar industry can be confusing after many weeks research we chose Cheif Electricians and the system they designed, customer service and installation was all first class.Adam answered all of the questions we had and as an electrican was knowledgeable and could answer all questions we had. (Tip: Choose an installer that is an electrician by trade not just a sales call centre)The team from Cheif Electricians were fantastic during the installation. Arrived punctually, respectful and communicated throughout the install on all aspects. In addition all team members have a passion for solar and  a focus on customer experience. (Tip: choose a company that covers everything end to end and doesn’t just sell and out source the installation

Adam, Hamish and the team were fantastic to deal with from the initial site visit right through to the follow up phone call from Jamey to ensure we were happy with the installation and service. Adam even followed up with the inspector to speed up the connection process.Adam was punctual when he did the initial site visit and listened to my requirements. He provided various proposals in a video format which was fantastic for comparison purposes. His installation team were punctual, polite and very tidy. On top of that, they were a great bunch of blokes who clearly enjoy their job.I could not fault the quality and neatness of the install as this was of utmost importance to myself.Overall I am very satisfied the system and how it is performing.I wouldn't hesitate in recommending Chief Electricians to anyone looking for a quality Solar System install.....in fact they are now my preferred company for any Electrical works we have in the future.

If you need a solar system, dont look any further.The whole team was fantastic to work with, from the initial quote through to completion. Their communcation was professional and their quality of work was exceptional.We ended up choosing them based on all of the other positive reviews and I'm glad we did. I can't recommend them highly enough!!

Adam and his team provided an excellent service from start to finish.  In particular they listened to what I wanted and worked to achieve that outcome.  I received quotes from five different installers, and while I ended up considering two companies seriously I ended to choosing Chief, because I felt they best met my needs.I found them punctual, polite and very friendly, they put up with my questions and were very helpful.  The installation went smoothly and it is a very neat and tidy job.  Overall I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone who is looking to install solar.
